steps.name: Ling
steps.text: What of Rhodes Island's plans after this?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Uh... er... huh? Did I ever introduce myself?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: What of your plans, even?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I've been planning to get this all behind me, go back and ask that aloof Mr. Liang... to pay my bills well.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Perhaps he was right. You and we are not solely together brought for this.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Only...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Leizi, how'd you...

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: I happened to learn from fellow disciples about the Mount Hui-ch'i business, and immediately rushed for Shangshu.

steps.name: Leizi
steps.text: I might've been a little late, but not too late after all.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: That's good, then.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Miss Ling.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I have a question.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: How do beings like you determine... er, who's older and younger?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Ah, establishing the pecking order.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Within a sea of chaos, whoever first finds that answer, first exists upon the human realm.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What answer's that?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: One to a question incredibly simple...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: ...'Who am I.'

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Mr. Taihe, Mr. Zuo Le. It's good to meet you.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Miss Ning. Good to meet you.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Assistant Minister Ning, my pleasure.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: 'Tis unbecoming of my etiquette that I could not offer you hospitality for your time in Shangshu.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: We came uninvited and troubled you greatly. We should be first to apologize.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You came on your father's orders, handling the goblet and Mount Hui-ch'i incidents in the Sui Regulator's name. 'Twas swift, fierce action.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Your insight is as a beacon, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: But Mr. Liang's actions, breaking past settled positions, were all the more admirable.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Were it not for the Sui Regulator's radicality, he may not have needed such drastic action.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: My conscience is clear. I imagine the Department of Discipline and Supervision will pursue their own amends once they learn of this.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: I've drawn up my report to the Emperor. It's open and fair. No bias allowed for.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: As you say, Mr. Taihe, 'garner loyalty and forsake righteousness.'

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: But the Sui Regulator has overstepped its ambit. No matter the Grand Tutor's determining, I will report the reality to the High Minister.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: As one should.
No need.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Zuo Le.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Here... here!

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: By your inference and in those circumstances, how long would you need to suppress the situation, should the three's Sui-Xiang roam the human realm to harm Shangshu?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: And should the bestial Sui have awakened, and Yan readied a city to fight it, what would the price be?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: The former would require three days' effort. The latter would be mutual loss, with the feranmut dead, and three-tenths of the army gone.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Liang Xun.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Here.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: If I sentenced you to death today, to protect the Ministry of Rites and Sui Regulator, what would you do?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Submit to the law, as I ought.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Then if by unexpected turns, your actions today led Shangshu City to be damaged and the common people harmed, what would you do?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Should I have sought a way for survival, then better late than never.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The game until now was of equal occupation.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The Lungmenite you chose was an unusual, irrational move, yet he seized some hint from it. A suboptimal piece.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Given so, how much more is within his reckoning? And how much that he hasn't accounted for will return to benefit him?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You perceive this matter finely, Grand Tutor.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Liang Xun. The one to take your place as magistrate will arrive at Shangshu within a month. Prepare the transition, and leave with me.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I... do not know what you mean, Grand Tutor.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Follow me to the capital.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: My thanks, Grand Tutor.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: But I still...

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: —I, Ning Ciqiu, congratulate Mr. Liang on his promotion.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Assistant Minister Ning.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Yumen's route back to Yan is set. It docked with Lungmen yesterday, to ready and resupply.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Was... Yumen City avoiding Catastrophe? Or...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: It had other purpose.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Leave for Yumen ahead of time. When I and Liang Xun finish business in the capital, we will naturally proceed for it too.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Right...! Understood.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Taihe.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: All is proceeding smoothly.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Uncle Taihe? So you long since...

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: 'Garner loyalty and forsake righteousness.' Blame me not, young man.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: We will withhold investigation into the Sui Regulator's lapse here for now. At present, only determining whither the one hundred and eighty-one black stones are is key.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Grand Tutor, when will you leave Shangshu?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Tomorrow eve.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: So very pressing. Need we not await the Messenger ranks' escort...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Unnecessary.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Tianshi Bai will want to send you off.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Unnecessary still.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Shangshu's mountain ways are rugged. I fear it may be dangerous if you are alone...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: What, as if wily criminals dare run amok within Shangshu's borders?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: No. I simply mind your advanced years. Be careful on lone outings, please...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Within Great Yan's domain under heaven, I only fear if the common people go without peace and national trade is not sufficiently prosperous.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: What else should I fear?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Is anything else worth my fear at all?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That's over with.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Past the fire of danger.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You certainly didn't feel the heat.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: But the danger weighed on us all.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So it was all your secret orders from the Sui Regulator, having me bring the cup from Lungmen back to Shangshu.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But your status stood in the way, and so did a certain someone by your side, so you had to put a thief's cap on me and get the escorts to act their show.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: —But you never coordinated that act with me, which I think shows you never wanted to put it on in the first place.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You know I never liked acting.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So was this your own idea?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But the Candleholders were in Shangshu, and they wouldn't give up at the drop of a hat.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You never even wanted this to go down in Shangshu, let alone the Sui Regulator usurping you for a while, them and the Ministry of Rites tearing into each other.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: True.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But if you had your way there, you'd be cast on injustice's side.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: And so there was someone who probably loved nosing, and probably felt very sorry for you, and he sent a bounty hunter to come steal the cup.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Since then it's a weight off your hands.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You know who that someone is.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Maybe I do.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But nobody foresaw Shang Zhong would come soaring through the sky, out for a life.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Things turned for the worse, and off everyone tumbled to Qujiang Peak and the Field of Forgotten Water. Not very smart work from you, no, not smart at all...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But for you, for Liang Xun, maybe it was a little too smart at the same time.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Which is why I entrusted you with it.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Someone who could both tell what I was thinking, and would never betray his friends.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Should I thank you for still considering me a friend?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: When all's said and done, though, I wasn't out to find who that goblet's owner was.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: What were you looking for?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You're still that same old you, filled with ambition as ever, aren't you.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You've gotten smarter, Liang Xun.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But that's just fine. Carry on, you.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I have a rough idea as to Huai Tianpei's whereabouts.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You've had a rough idea for ages. You just didn't want me distracted.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Are you upset at me for not telling you?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I was more worried I'd need to keep assisting you.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: There's been a rumor going about the world of Yanese kung fu lately.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Ah, the martial world's rumors.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: When there's kung fu involved, he could hardly be left out of things.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Hmm. Shangshu's a fine place.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: The plum blossoms bloomed late this year, and I wondered why; so your private visit to this city it was. A rare, rare guest.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: When did you master this place?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: If wished you did to look into it deeply, I could be considered half of these mountains' master true.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The point in question isn't in the persons. It's in you, and your collective.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: When the day comes, what sides you stand on, what ways you see things, which ways your hearts feel, will all determine what is lost in the battle there and then.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Yan is a hard foe to defeat.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: You do have the right to speak on behalf of Yan's army.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: You and that learned master held the north for a hundred years apiece, it must be recognized. If not for that, the court would hardly remember you so fondly.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The Sui Regulator's deeds may be sensed to encroach, but no matter what, you are fondly cherished.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: The years and months tower tall, joys parted with so reluctantly.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: To this day, in my deepest drunken depths, still my ears prick at horns sounding battalions forth.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: ...Nian.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Uh-huh.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The court wants to make a deal with you.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Well how about that. I thought I'd be getting my execution date.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The Chamber of Heaven's Designs hasn't ceased once in a whole millennium. Countless troops and tianshi lie buried in action in the north, yet evil rises as virtue does. The slaughter of wicked spirits is endless, and we've not been able to close the book on it.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The finest of soldiers, the grandest of marshals, the wisest of tianshi, all rush to man the frigid north, year upon year upon year.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The court wants you to erect twelve pagodas and five cities outside the Chamber of Heaven's Designs. Three thousand mechanisms, millions of terracottas.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: You needn't do it immediately. Nor will you be on your own. Yan has begun sorting it out, drafting blueprints, and assigning every great tianshi to the case.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: I hope you will lend a hand. It'll allow someone to make a return from that tower, at least.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Who?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: One who would never fall, but absolutely must never fall.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: You're kidding. I heard some of the rumors from Leizi. Her founder was a super-annoying guy... even if she never met him.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Hmph... a special case of a long life warped by dependence on Originium. Such humankind really doesn't agree with me...

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Isn't this just because she gave you all that hassle?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Ah... I remember her.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Is she still well?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: She is.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: She's been stationed at the north for over three hundred and seventy years now. If she can return home, the court would be willing to let her rest at ease, allow her a peaceful retirement...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: But the man always says he'd hate to be idle.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Sounds like some major engineering work. What do I get out of it, then?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The court will help you with what you want to do.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: The wild bestial of bloodshot eyes can't be caged forever.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Hah. It all sounds like a win-win for you. We Yan people sure love to haggle...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: That's all on that. Think about it.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: I have a matter I'd like to ask of you in turn.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: Please, go on.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: As of now, is he...

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: His actions surpassed all feranmutologists' predictions. Turning his own flesh into one hundred and eighty-one black stones... scattering them in the human realm... hmm.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: He wants to set up a game across the entire land.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: In his endgame days, he'll surely appear again. You'd best ask him yourself then.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: It's a game we must win.

steps.name: Grand Tutor
steps.text: We cannot lose.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Did you hear that, you two?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Would he lose to this Grand Tutor, playing on nineteen by nineteen?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Of course he wouldn't.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Then how did the Grand Tutor beat him?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: The Grand Tutor did not play go with him.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Black and white in their millions upon nineteen by nineteen—it has its intrigue, true, but the Grand Tutor speaks that absorbed within a board of pieces, he cannot see man.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Man?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Thus the Grand Tutor played a different game with him. With Yan's domain as the board, with the land's every commoner as the pieces.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Who won?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: The Grand Tutor, at that time. Thus he was willingly bound in captivity by Yan, and with every loss, he would stay prisoner sixty years.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: Heh. If Yan always had a genius to beat him, he'd never get a foot out of the capital his whole life, huh?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Who can profess to know? He's very poor at the chesses, truth be told.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Very slow to learn them, too. Centuries ago, in one cycle of sixty years, he lost hundreds upon thousands of games. The following cycle, he lost some less, and after one more, no more than a hundred games, give or take.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: And so forth, until a point when no one was left who could beat him.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Thus on that cycle, he left the capital... and so that incident transpired.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: That's when our third sis...

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: We could all sense that this was no pleasant matter.

steps.name: Nian
steps.text: So the Grand Tutor had to kick his ass before he dragged his own tail back to the capital, ready to be punished?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Perhaps it was a good, long while since last he lost in one fell swoop.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Or it may be... that his sights were not set on Yan alone anymore.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: So you're Ning Ciqiu.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: And you, the bounty hunter of enough bravery to plunder a Tianshi Bureau procession.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: I-I didn't know they were good guys yet...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Where's that old man anyway? The Bai guy?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: I will take you to meet him.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: I think, in this turn of events, thanks are due for you.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: It's alright.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: But I still don't get the full picture. Wasn't it just a goblet? If you knew where it was, couldn't you go sneak it off yourself and be done with it?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: He would not want to hand it to me, so I could hardly take it.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: So you got me to help? Why?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Why, I wonder.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: I simply did not want him drawn into so many vexing matters, without the slightest self-awareness.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: So this bounty hunter really was yours, Assistant Minister Ning.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You need not raise your hackles. They are not enemies.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Only...

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It was the Sui Regulator who hastened in its conduct; we won't question her deeply. Er... as long as she entered Yan's borders through legitimate means, of course...

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Go and meet with Tianshi Bai, Blacknight. He awaits you at the agreed location.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Alright. You take care.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You'd seen through both the Sui Regulator and Mr. Liang's schemes.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Not too long ago.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: But you seem to not have seen through Mr. Liang's plans to mediate from within.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: He may simply have been apprehensive about betraying you, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Regardless, the Sui Regulator overstepped their bounds in this. We will later address the matter ourselves with the Ministry of Rites.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: It is no matter. 'Tis all to plan further for Yan.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: 'Tis cold outside; may you all rest soon. I will go see young Blacknight; 'tis her first time in Yan, and I cannot rest easy.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: Farewell, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Be safe.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Lord Zuo.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: I can only hope this pair in love... aren't shaken by big things to come.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: You're young, Lord Zuo. To say such things invites ideas of feigned maturity.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: As a Candleholder, I've none of my own ties of the sort.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: If I may boldly mention, when you previously passed through that village and dealt with bandits, you did have—

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: *cough*, *cough*—I trust that girl was only repaying the favor! How can you muddle this with affairs between the sexes?

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: It was a life saved. If the intent was impure, that would only further serve doubts of advantage being taken.

steps.name: Zuo Le
steps.text: You presume wrong, Uncle Taihe.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Taihe
steps.text: It is as you say, young man.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Not heading back to Lungmen, Mr. Lee?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: No. There's still someone I need to find.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Come with?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I'm stopping by the branch office with the funnyman anyhow, and then I've got to get back to the Rhodes Island landship...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It seems we'll be tagging along. But I'd rather not be a nuisance to Rhodes Island again.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: No need to stand on honor.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Trust me, it's personal matters.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That codename Nothing operator got drawn into all this mess, had his leg hurt for nothing, and he's still in the hospital now. Don't want to give you all any more grief than that.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: That's good, then.

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: K-Kroos!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Oh, fancy that! Mulberry!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: If you're in Shangshu already, I'm guessing Lava got to the branch office a while ago, then?

steps.name: Mulberry
steps.text: Y-Yeah... and Lava wanted me to tell you too, it's best you head there quickly. It seems like something else happened...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Ahaha... this trip to Yan sure never takes a breather.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It happens.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It used to just be around Lungmen and stuff... oh, right.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I've been wanting to ask. You said Mr. Liang and Wei Yenwu are real alike, but alike how?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Did I say that?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You did. After we met him, I was even thinking, wait, they're completely different...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Mmm...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, after all... both their sweethearts have them by the ears.

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: You're back.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: A hundred and eighty-one black stones. You'll beat Sui to losing your sanity.

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: While you've already spent all these years in here, in your drunken stupor? No... the years and months mean nothing to you.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: That farce of the Xingyu Escort Association was a move planned out by you.

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: Not totally.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: They should be clean of responsibility for me... Why swallow them all into this?

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: Just as a reminder.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: A reminder to me?

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: Here you dream of all under heaven. Though you know how the universe dwarfs all, the grass in spring still tugs at your heart.

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: From Jiangnan, up to Saibei, then back to this summit atop the clouds, you've changed a lot. It disturbs me, little sister, so I warn you.

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: Warn you that the feelings of man are not so pure as those moralists would have you believe.
Sat on equally pitted sides, the brother is in strife, love and disgust and passion and resentment all taken as pieces to the game.
You don't fear them now. Of course you don't. But sooner or later, you will. Nian will, Dusk will. They've become too much like people, so they will come to fear those things.
That is all... this little warning is.

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: Are you angered?

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: The cup should only hold wine; wine should not be so wordy.
In that instant, all things halt.
Shangshu's Three Mounts and Seventeen Peaks now have one more peak, and countless more trees, with countless more branches, with countless more leaves.
Wind blows, but the leaves are still.
Shangshu once had a Catastrophe.
The devastating storm loose with sparks, shattered Originium crystals descending like fiery rain.

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: —Shangshu—once had a Catastrophe!

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: Someone—offered wine to the heavens, and the black clouds parted, and the people were safe! And yet now, you're going to fling this goblet to the black clouds!
A black goblet. A black piece.
In the face of the most terrifying disaster of all the land, all trace is instantly annihilated.

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: Are you feeling wrathful? Compassionate? Envious?

steps.name: Voice in the Cup
steps.text: Carve these emotions into you—things are soon to come—

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Things, soon to come... Certainly, I cannot stay uninvolved... isn't that right.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: Phew... haah.

steps.name: Ling
steps.text: For now, I shall go purchase wine.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'll be leaving Shangshu.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I won't stop you.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: If two people want to kill each other, the feelings aren't too hard to understand.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: But if two people want to be killed by the other...

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Then we should save the effort. We'd just be wallowing.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: I'm planning to retire now.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Du Yaoye still isn't ready for it. And doesn't the girl seem just a little like she wants her own business?

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: If so, I'll shutter things.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Don't you agree?

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I'm not one of the escorts.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: Zheng Qingyue. Our business is only postponed for a while. We're not shaking hands and making up here.

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Association custom says you don't talk grudges when you're at the bar. I'll be in Shangshu anyhow, waiting for you.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: One last thing.

steps.name: Pole-Carrier
steps.text: I hear...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Dad! Master Shang!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: What are you charging in here about...?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I've decided! Me and the guys all talked it through!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: We're going to Yumen!
